name: Adamas AX nut-fastened front hub
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 194 g for the nut-fastened, solid-axle, 36-hole front FH-AD61 hub, 93 mm OLD. The manufacturer drawing confirms hub nuts and no quick-release skewer. Nuts and axle hardware are not subtracted.
